insight.title: Why Your Brain Needs Two Videos at Once
insight.subtitle: The rise of split-screen media reveals how we now need a visual pacifier to stay focused online.
insight.notificationHook: Your brain now needs two videos at once

sections.text: If you’ve scrolled social media recently, you’ve seen them: a movie scene playing on top, and a mesmerizing video of soap cutting or mobile gameplay running on the bottom.
This isn’t random clutter. It is a kinetic pacifier designed to satisfy the hyper-distracted brain, keeping your eyes occupied just enough so your mind can actually process the main story.
It suggests our attention has become so fragmented that narrative alone is no longer enough. We now require secondary, mindless stimulation just to tolerate the primary content we chose to watch.
We now need entertainment just to pay attention to our entertainment.
